findings.consequence: Src inhibitor (SKI606): selective toxicity to SAC-alleviated CIN cells
findings.system: human cell lines with spindle checkpoint alleviation (compound screen), 2020
findings.sentence: Furthermore, cells with an ongoing CIN phenotype, induced by spindle assembly checkpoint (SAC) alleviation, are significantly more sensitive to the Src kinase inhibitor SKI606.
findings.caveats: SKI606 is the research name of bosutinib (not named in abstract; verify). In vitro CIN induced by SAC alleviation (not BUB1B mutation); toxic to dividing cells with weak SAC, so could be harmful to MVA tissues or useful against a tumour; no dose/PK data; bosutinib is approved for CML only.

findings.consequence: chemical chaperone prevents premature senescence in trisomic fibroblasts
findings.system: human trisomy 21/18/13 fibroblasts and T21 iPSC-derived fibroblasts, 2019
findings.sentence: Notably, 4-PBA treatment successfully prevented the progression of premature senescence in secondary fibroblasts derived from trisomy 21 iPSCs.
findings.caveats: Aneuploidy-associated proteotoxic stress in whole-chromosome trisomy, not BUB1B-mosaic aneuploidy; in vitro only; 4-PBA approved for urea cycle disorders; high doses in vitro; relevance to the child growth/muscle phenotype unproven.

findings.consequence: decreases protein aggregates and apoptosis in trisomic neurons
findings.sentence: Intriguingly, treatment with sodium 4-phenylbutyrate, a chemical chaperone, successfully decreased the formation of protein aggregates and prevented the progression of cell apoptosis in trisomic neurons.
findings.caveats: Neurons (not muscle/kidney); trisomy not mosaic aneuploidy; in vitro.

findings.consequence: JAK inhibition improves clinical course in Down syndrome with STAT1 GOF (interferon signalling)
findings.system: two patients (one with trisomy 21 + STAT1 GOF), 2025
findings.sentence: Both patients showed significant clinical improvement with the Janus kinase (JAK) inhibitor ruxolitinib.
findings.caveats: Improvement mainly in patient with STAT1 gain-of-function; persistent inflammation in the DS patient; trisomy 21, not MVA; no evidence that MVA cells have an interferon signature requiring JAK inhibition; immunosuppression/infection risk in a child with cancer predisposition.

findings.consequence: JAK inhibitor class (drug not named in abstract) normalises interferon signature in Down syndrome case
findings.system: Down syndrome cohort plus longitudinal case study, 2023
findings.sentence: Last, a longitudinal case study demonstrated that JAK inhibition normalizes interferon signatures with therapeutic benefit in DS.
findings.caveats: Single case; DS interferonopathy (chr21 interferon receptor genes), which is not established for BUB1B-mosaic aneuploidy; drug class only.

findings.consequence: glucocorticoid receptor agonists selectively reduce viability of aneuploid cancer cell lines
findings.system: PRISM screen (578 cancer lines, 4518 compounds) plus TCGA, 2025
findings.sentence: Pathway-altering compounds that selectively reduce viability in cells with aneuploidy profiles were discovered, including an unexpectedly prominent number of glucocorticoid receptor agonists.
findings.caveats: Computational association in cancer cell lines (specific aneuploid losses); no individual drug named in abstract (class includes approved dexamethasone, prednisolone); glucocorticoids also impair growth and muscle in children, so a risk rather than a lead for this child.

findings.consequence: reduced-intensity conditioning for HSCT in MVA1 patient
findings.system: 11-year-old boy with BUB1B-mutated MVA1 (MDS with monosomy 7), 2019
findings.sentence: Due to severe dependence on blood transfusions, a TCRαβ+/CD19+ depleted HSCT was performed from a matched unrelated donor (MUD) using a treosulfan-based reduced intensity conditioning (RIC) regimen.
findings.caveats: Single patient; conditioning tolerated but graft rejection, sepsis and death at day +156; different BUB1B alleles and indication (MDS); no data on rhabdomyosarcoma.

findings.consequence: Src/SFK inhibitor sensitivity in cells overexpressing CIN gene TPX2
findings.system: breast cancer cells with inducible CIN-gene expression (drug screen), 2024
findings.sentence: We find that the overexpression of targeting protein for Xklp2 (TPX2) enhances sensitivity to the proto-oncogene c-Src (SRC) inhibitor dasatinib due to activation of the Yes-associated protein 1 (YAP) pathway.
findings.caveats: Sensitivity linked to TPX2 overexpression/YAP, not to SAC weakness; breast cancer; dasatinib is also a component of the D+Q senolytic combination but that was not tested here.

findings.consequence: ROCK inhibitor increases proliferation and reduces inflammatory gene expression in T21 progenitors
findings.system: human trisomy 21 neural progenitor cells (24 candidate drugs), 2026
findings.sentence: The Rho-associated coiled-coil kinase inhibitor fasudil increased proliferation of T21 NPCs, reduced expression of inflammatory pathway genes in T21 NPCs, and reduced markers of inflammation in LPS-stimulated microglial model systems.
findings.caveats: Neural progenitors, trisomy 21; fasudil approved in Japan/China, not FDA/EMA; relevance to BUB1B-MVA unknown.

background_evidence.consequence: trisomic cells: constitutive cGAS-STING/type I interferon activation drives autophagy
background_evidence.system: human trisomic cells and primary trisomic fibroblasts, 2021
background_evidence.sentence: Trisomic cells accumulate cytoplasmic dsDNA, which activates the cGAS-STING signaling cascade, thereby triggering nuclear accumulation of the transcription factor IRF3 and, consequently, upregulation of interferon-stimulated genes. cGAS depletion interferes with TFEB-dependent upregulation of autophagy in model trisomic cells.
background_evidence.caveats: Mechanism only; no drug tested; whole-chromosome trisomy not mosaic aneuploidy.

background_evidence.consequence: aneuploid cells: TFEB-mediated lysosomal stress, limited autophagic degradation
background_evidence.sentence: Here we show that autophagosomal cargo such as protein aggregates accumulate within lysosomes in aneuploid cells.
background_evidence.caveats: Mechanism; supports caution with lysosomal inhibitors (chloroquine) and consideration of autophagy enhancers; no drug in this paper.

background_evidence.consequence: aneuploid cells: impaired HSF1/HSP90 protein folding
background_evidence.sentence: Here, we report that human aneuploid cells are impaired in HSP90-mediated protein folding.
background_evidence.caveats: Mechanism; no approved HSP90 inhibitor (17-AAG not approved); already covered in round 1.

background_evidence.consequence: aneuploid cells more sensitive to proteasome inhibition and RNA degradation perturbation
background_evidence.system: multiple diploid vs aneuploid human cell models, cancer lines, myeloma patients, 2024
background_evidence.sentence: At the protein level, aneuploid cells mitigate proteotoxic stress by reducing protein translation and increasing protein degradation, rendering them more sensitive to proteasome inhibition.
background_evidence.caveats: Proteasome inhibitors already covered in round 1; bortezomib not named in this sentence (myeloma patients treated with proteasome inhibitors); cytotoxic, narrow window for a child.

background_evidence.consequence: aneuploid cells: increased reliance on pyrimidine biosynthesis and OXPHOS (nucleotide pool insufficiency)
background_evidence.system: isogenic aneuploid/diploid human mammary epithelial cells, genome-wide CRISPR screen, 2025
background_evidence.sentence: Our study reveals that aneuploid HMECs exhibit an increased reliance on pyrimidine biosynthesis and mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation genes and demonstrate heightened fitness advantages upon loss of tumor suppressor genes.
background_evidence.caveats: Cell-line CRISPR screen; suggests nucleoside salvage supplementation or DHODH/OXPHOS inhibition as hypotheses but no approved drug tested.

background_evidence.consequence: CIN cells: polyamine/SAM metabolism dependency; spermine rescues
background_evidence.sentence: Feeding animals spermine was seen to rescue the cell death caused by the loss of SAM synthase in CIN tissues.
background_evidence.caveats: Drosophila; polyamine inhibition (e.g. eflornithine, approved) was proposed but not tested; in a child with growth failure polyamine depletion could also be harmful.

background_evidence.consequence: antioxidant feeding rescues aneuploidy-driven neurological phenotype
background_evidence.sentence: Feeding animals an antioxidant rescued the climbing and seizure phenotype.
background_evidence.caveats: Antioxidant not named (N-acetylcysteine not confirmed); Drosophila SAC-gene depletion; neuronal phenotype.

background_evidence.consequence: antioxidant treatment reduces chromosome missegregation in aged human fibroblasts
background_evidence.sentence: Antioxidant treatment reduced the frequency of chromosome missegregation and micronuclei, suggesting that oxidative stress causes CIN.
background_evidence.caveats: Oxidative-stress-induced CIN in normal ageing, not BUB1B mutation; antioxidant not specified.

background_evidence.consequence: ROS scavengers, mitochondrial chaperones and apoptosis inhibition dampen aneuploidy effects in MVA fly model
background_evidence.system: Drosophila SAC-gene neural stem cell MVA model, 2026
background_evidence.sentence: We identify overexpression of Radical Oxygen Species scavengers, mitochondria chaperones and apoptosis inhibition as genetic interventions capable of dampening the deleterious effects of aneuploidy on brain size.
background_evidence.caveats: Genetic (not drug) interventions in Drosophila brain; supports mitochondrial/proteostasis axis for antioxidants or chaperones as hypothesis only.

background_evidence.consequence: p16Ink4a-positive cell clearance (genetic) delays tumorigenesis and organ deterioration
background_evidence.sentence: The clearance of p16(Ink4a)-positive cells delayed tumorigenesis and attenuated age-related deterioration of several organs without apparent side effects, including kidney, heart and fat, where clearance preserved the functionality of glomeruli, cardio-protective KATP channels and adipocytes, respectively.
background_evidence.caveats: Genetic clearance in normal ageing mice, no senolytic drug, no BUB1B deficiency; indirect only.

background_evidence.consequence: mitotic errors activate p53/p21 via nuclear envelope mechanics; mTORC2 and ATR as sensors
background_evidence.system: human cells with tunable chromosome mis-segregation, 2025
background_evidence.sentence: We identify mTORC2 and ATR as nuclear deformation sensors upstream of p53/p21 activation.
background_evidence.caveats: Mechanism; no drug tested; inhibiting this checkpoint could permit aneuploid survival (risk).

background_evidence.consequence: MYC- and p53-driven cell competition eliminates aneuploid hPSCs
background_evidence.sentence: Aneuploid hPSCs with lower MYC or higher p53 levels relative to diploid neighbors are outcompeted but conversely gain an advantage when MYC and p53 relative abundance switches.
background_evidence.caveats: Stem-cell system; no drug tested; p53 inhibitors could favour aneuploid cells (risk).

background_evidence.consequence: aneuploid yeast: ribosome quality control failure causes premature ageing
background_evidence.sentence: Remarkably, inducing ribosome stalling in euploids produces similar aging phenotypes, while up-regulating limiting RQC subunits or poly-ubiquitin alleviates many of the aneuploid defects.
background_evidence.caveats: Yeast; no drug; ribosome-biogenesis/translation axis only.

not_approved.consequence: KIF18A inhibitors: SAC-defective cells survive; BUBR1 recruitment impaired in resistant cells
not_approved.sentence: SAC-proficient SCLC cells underwent sustained mitotic arrest followed by apoptotic cell death upon KIF18A inhibition, whereas SAC-defective cells failed to maintain checkpoint activation and survived.
not_approved.caveats: KIF18A inhibitors investigational; shows SAC-defective cells are resistant to mitotic-arrest killing.

not_approved.sentence: Our results identify a therapeutically relevant, synthetic lethal interaction between aneuploidy and the SAC.
not_approved.caveats: SAC inhibitors (MPS1, KIF18A) are investigational; approved drugs not tested.

not_approved.consequence: high CDC20 increases sensitivity to MPS1 inhibitors
not_approved.sentence: We recently reported that aneuploid cancer cells are preferentially sensitive to SAC inhibition.

not_approved.consequence: ZLN005 energy-metabolism drug selectively toxic to aneuploid cells
not_approved.system: aneuploid vs euploid human cells (compound screen), 2020
not_approved.sentence: We find that aneuploid cells are much more sensitive to the energy metabolism regulating drug ZLN005 than their euploid counterparts.
not_approved.caveats: ZLN005 is a research compound (PGC-1alpha activator), not approved.

not_approved.consequence: POLE exonuclease deficiency synthetic lethal in highly aneuploid cells
not_approved.sentence: Functional experiments demonstrated that POLE exonuclease activity is essential for the viability of highly aneuploid cancer cell lines but dispensable in diploid cells.
not_approved.caveats: No inhibitor exists; large chromosome-arm losses context.

not_approved.consequence: CDK2 inhibition triggers anaphase catastrophe in aneuploid cancers
not_approved.sentence: This review addresses how cyclin-dependent kinase 2 (CDK2) inhibition targets a broad array of aneuploid cancers for proapoptotic death by engaging a death program called anaphase catastrophe.

not_approved.consequence: CDC7 inhibitor TAK-931 produces senescence-like aneuploid cells with SASP/inflammation
not_approved.sentence: TAK-931 induce RS, generating senescence-like aneuploid cells, which highly expressed inflammatory cytokines and chemokines (senescence-associated secretory phenotype, SASP).
not_approved.caveats: Investigational drug; shows replication stress can create aneuploid inflammatory senescent cells.

not_approved.consequence: STAT3 inhibition kills CIN colorectal cancer cells via PLK1 and SAC hyperactivation
not_approved.sentence: In our effort to identify therapeutic vulnerability in PTEN-deficient CRC, we found that PTEN-deficient CRC cells exhibited elevated CIN phenotype and were hypersensitive to STAT3 inhibition.
not_approved.caveats: STAT3 inhibitors not approved for this use; PTEN-deficient context.

not_approved.consequence: NAD+ precursor NMN raises BubR1 protein in mice; SIRT2 overexpression extends BubR1 H/H lifespan
not_approved.sentence: Overexpression of SIRT2 or treatment of mice with the NAD(+) precursor nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) increases BubR1 abundance in vivo.
not_approved.caveats: NMN is a supplement, not an approved drug in most jurisdictions; the BubR1 increase was shown in wild-type tissues; MVA1 patients with truncating mutation (p.Leu737*) on one allele may still make some BUBR1 from the other allele, but benefit is unproven; nicotinamide riboside is analogous and unapproved.

not_approved.consequence: apigenin reduces oxidative stress in trisomy 21 amniocytes
not_approved.system: human T21 amniocytes and Ts1Cje mice, 2020
not_approved.sentence: In vitro, T21 cells cultured with apigenin had significantly reduced oxidative stress and improved antioxidant defense response.
not_approved.caveats: Supplement/phytochemical, not an approved drug; prenatal DS context.

No aneuploidy/MVA/BUB1B study naming NAC found; only unspecified antioxidants (PMIDs 38693434, 41290707).
No study in aneuploid, trisomic or BubR1-deficient cells found (CoQ10 hits were unrelated ageing papers).

No study in aneuploid/BubR1-deficient cells; only genetic p16 clearance in wild-type mice (PMID 26840489).
No approved STING inhibitor; hydroxychloroquine/aspirin as cGAS modulators not tested in aneuploid cells.
No aneuploid-cell drug data other than 4-PBA; UPR deficiency in yeast gives aneuploidy (PMID 40846641) but no therapy.
No drug study in aneuploid cells; p53 role only mechanistic (PMIDs 40409259, 39779939).
No direct test; pyrimidine dependency of aneuploid cells (PMID 40324880) is a hypothesis only.
No CIN study; only polyamine dependency in Drosophila (PMID 37233683).

no_evidence.drug: PARP / ATR / WEE1 inhibitors in BUB1B-deficient cells
no_evidence.note: No BUB1B/MVA-specific data retrieved (PARP inhibitors approved; ATR/WEE1 investigational).

No DepMap/Open Targets claim for an approved drug in BUB1B-low cells found; Cohen-Sharir 2021 (PMID 33505028) is the main DepMap-based aneuploidy analysis and only identifies investigational SAC/KIF18A targets.

against_or_risk.consequence: CDK4/6 inhibitors induce chromosomal instability as part of antitumour effect
against_or_risk.sentence: Recent mechanistic evidence suggests that in addition to stalling the cell cycle, the antitumor effects of CDK4/6i involve the induction of chromosomal instability (CIN).
against_or_risk.caveats: Class (palbociclib, ribociclib, abemaciclib approved) not named in sentence; in cancer cells; relevant only as caution to avoid CIN-inducing drugs in a child with SAC defect.

against_or_risk.consequence: aneuploid cells with copy gain: sensitivity to DNA-damaging chemotherapeutics
against_or_risk.system: isogenic aneuploid human mammary epithelial cells, 2025
against_or_risk.sentence: Although diploid cells can switch seamlessly between pyrimidine synthesis and salvage, cells with increased chromosomal content exhibit p53 activation and S-phase arrest when relying on salvage alone, alongside increased sensitivity to DNA-damaging chemotherapeutics.
against_or_risk.caveats: Cell-line observation; drugs not named; suggests increased chemotherapy toxicity in aneuploid cells, to consider for rhabdomyosarcoma regimens.

against_or_risk.consequence: BUB1B variants reduce BubR1, increase PCS/CIN and drive resistance to Taxol-based therapy
against_or_risk.system: human cells and carriers lymphocytes with BUB1B variants, 2024
against_or_risk.sentence: We further show that BUB1B variants lead to decreased BubR1 expression and/or stability, which promotes increased premature chromatid separation and, consequently, triggers CIN, driving resistance to Taxol-based therapies.
against_or_risk.caveats: Monoallelic germline BUB1B variants (prostate cancer), not biallelic MVA1; resistance means loss of efficacy of microtubule poisons (also relevant to vincristine in rhabdomyosarcoma, not tested).

against_or_risk.consequence: BUB1B knockdown attenuates paclitaxel-induced cell death
against_or_risk.system: PANC-1 human pancreatic cancer cells, CRISPR screen, 2024
against_or_risk.sentence: Knockdown of these SAC genes (BUB1B, BUB3, and TTK) attenuates paclitaxel-induced cell death.
against_or_risk.caveats: BUB1B knockdown in a cancer line, not patient cells; suggests microtubule-targeting drugs (taxanes, possibly vinca alkaloids) may be less effective in BUBR1-low cells.

against_or_risk.consequence: BUB1B knockdown reduces apoptosis induced by Aurora kinase inhibition
against_or_risk.system: HPV-positive squamous cancer cell lines (864-drug screen), 2022
against_or_risk.sentence: Knockdown of MAD2L1 or BUB1B reduced Aurora kinase inhibition-induced apoptosis, whereas depletion of the MAD2L1 regulator TRIP13 enhanced it.
against_or_risk.caveats: Aurora kinase inhibitors are not approved; cancer cell lines; indicates SAC-weak cells escape mitotic-arrest drugs.

note: Round-2 drug-agnostic search via Europe PMC REST (core records); all sentences copied verbatim from abstracts by code, verified=false pending external re-fetch. Strongest approved leads: sodium phenylbutyrate (chaperone, trisomic fibroblast senescence), JAK inhibitor/ruxolitinib (interferon in trisomy 21, not shown in MVA), bosutinib/SKI606 (toxic to SAC-weak cells; harm or anti-tumour), glucocorticoids (selectively reduce aneuploid cancer line viability; risk), treosulfan RIC HSCT (single MVA1 patient, L3). No approved drug has L2 benefit evidence in BUB1B-deficient cells. Risk: BUB1B loss reduces response to microtubule poisons (paclitaxel; vincristine not tested) and SAC mitotic-arrest drugs. Many mechanism papers are Drosophila/yeast/cell-line (L1 or L0). Some entries have drug null when the abstract names only a class.
